summary: Iteration 4 verified new features: (1) settings.page_title persists via PUT and drives document.title on /site/demo (observed 'DAYKO - Güncel Giriş'); (2) SiteSettings defaults include background_image_url=/backgrounds/casino.jpg and the asset is reachable HTTP 200 (~587KB); (3) border_style/border_width/gradient/font settings persist and are returned by /api/public/resolve; (4) per-card border_style/border_color/border_from/border_to persist through POST /api/sites/{id}/cards and PUT /api/cards/{id} and are exposed in public payload; (5) public page renders neon-border cards with image-on-top and styled uppercase title bar below (screenshot confirms). Added 4 new pytest tests -> 21/21 pass in ~10.7s. Playwright: logged in, opened site editor, switched to Görünüm tab, verified data-testids set-page-title, preset-casino-bg, set-border-style, set-font-size, live-preview are all present; changed border style to Neon via shadcn Select and dropdown updated.
critical_code_review_comments: SiteSettings default background_image_url='/backgrounds/casino.jpg' works because the asset is bundled under frontend/public/backgrounds/. Backend does not serve this path; it is intentionally served by the frontend which is correct for a same-origin preview.
public_site_payload returns border_style/border_color/border_from/border_to per card - values are None when not set (inherit from site). Verified.
create_card uses **data.model_dump() so new CardInput fields flow through cleanly; PUT /api/cards/{id} also accepts them.
PublicSiteRenderer sets document.title from settings.page_title only when not in preview mode - safe.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_-prefixed sites and delete them within the same test (finally block).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New selectors: set-page-title, preset-casino-bg, set-border-style, set-font-size (in Görünüm tab), card-border-style (in card dialog), live-preview, sponsor-card-{n}. Public payload now includes settings.page_title, border_style, border_width, border_gradient_from/to, card_font_size, card_font_weight, card_text_transform; and per-card border_style/border_color/border_from/border_to.
